scope: Narrow correction of the already frozen dispatcher-only image_review_changed invariant. No wire/PRD, dependency, permission or production change.

finding.cause: appendEvents forces roles=[dispatcher] but preserves input.participantIds; eventPage accepts role OR explicit participant ID. A downstream misdirected image event can therefore reach a non-dispatcher participant.
finding.proof: Lead Workerd fault-injection probe using actual public factory/Hono/SQLite DO: authenticated owner metadata reducer emits image_review_changed with audience contributor + participantIds=[contributor participant]. Contributor GET events returns1 matching event; expected0. Command and GET both200. Probe failed its privacy assertion, not setup.
finding.qualification: Fault-injected trusted reducer misconfiguration proves missing projection defense; not a claim that public users can register reducers or directly bypass command permissions.

required_fix: Enforce dispatcher-only delivery independent of participantIds and caller-specified audience; consider both append normalization and read-time defense for already misdirected rows.
Add real Workerd regression(s) for contributor/driver/viewer explicit participant targeting, dispatcher visibility and hidden scan-cursor progress. JSON and SSE must share the corrected projection.
Keep safe resource IDs only; no image/advice text, capabilities, operational revision mutation or new model/reward behavior.
